chose: Img in components/ui/img.tsx — a drop-in with fallback/forceFallback, alt required, and failed-src tracked by value
over: onError only, no SSR completeness check
because: Name: this should become the default image element (12 call sites hand-roll the same src-present conditional and none handle a 404), so the name must not read as special-purpose; Img is a drop-in and swapping , so wrapping one silently switches that rule off at every call site — the type restores it. failedSrc stores WHICH src failed, not a boolean, so a caller swapping in a working URL clears the fallback without every call site remembering to key by src. The mount effect checking img.complete && naturalWidth === 0 is not a corner case: pages are SSR'd, so the browser starts fetching from the HTML and a dead URL routinely settles before hydration, and onError alone would never fire.
